scope: SkillHone-guided architecture-level self-evolution for articulated contact and deformable flower dynamics
summary: A complete two-architecture, two-probe tournament rejects both the current pixel pipeline and the unrendered metric articulated-rod architecture, while automatically emitting five structural repairs and refusing numeric hyperparameter search or average-score promotion.
evidence: The complete tournament evaluates pixel-source-lock-v6 and metric-articulated-rod-residual-v1 over frames 0--329 and 330--659 with six immutable gates per row.
The pixel family fails articulated metric hand, metric force closure, persistent instance identity, and high-resolution review in both probes and causal stem motion in the first probe.

The new family has executable contracts, a rooted damped-rod backbone, a 6-D frictional force-closure certificate, causal auditing, and synthetic adversarial tests, but every unobserved real-video gate remains false and it is not promoted.

The mutation plan names articulated hand state, metric contact state, rooted deformable object dynamics, persistent object memory, and non-overridable high-resolution review; every mutation is marked architecture_not_hyperparameter.
SkillHone strict offline static checking passes evolve-demo-video-factory with no errors or warnings.
The SkillHone remote/model-graded status preflight stops with missing Forgejo url/token because ~/.skillhone/settings.json is absent; no official optim.py result is claimed.
lessons: A self-evolution loop must keep candidate promotion separate from architecture repair recommendation.
Code-level synthetic validity cannot be promoted as real-video evidence when the metric reconstruction and rendered candidate do not exist.
Two chronological halves provide same-video coverage but not independent-scene generalization.
limitations: The tournament has only one underlying source scene and cannot establish cross-scene, cross-object, or cross-embodiment generalization.
No remote SkillHone model-graded optimization ran because its required configured Forgejo backend is unavailable.
No real metric-articulated-rod rendered candidate exists for comparison.
next_actions: Run the metric state reconstruction and force/rod rollout on at least two independent licensed scenes, render full 660-frame candidates, and promote only if every physical, visual, adversarial, and human-review gate passes.
